Gauges

Gauges display a single value as a proportion of a maximum. Useful for dashboards and status indicators.

Syntax

::: gauge
title = Status
value = 75
max = 100
label = percent
:::

Example: Factory Metrics

Overall Efficiency
Furnace Temperature

Example: Resource Levels

Coal Reserve
Water Supply

Example: Machine Health

Drill Integrity
Conveyor Wear
